stages.title: 材料與基板
stages.description: 以三個技術單元完成「材料與基板」的模型及判讀，共六項獨立保存的作業。

steps.title: 材料選擇：模型與設計
steps.objective: 針對「材料選擇」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for material selection.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，標出「材料選擇」的輸入、輸出及量測基準，再在學徒工作台排列對應元件或資料流。CdTe、CIGS 與非晶矽不能共用所有參數。 在離線草圖或試算表建立基準與擾動兩種情境，寫出因果預測；用「列能隙、吸收與穩定差異。」規劃如何反駁模型。把未知參數、單位與邊界記錄在學習筆記。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for material selection, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. CdTe, CIGS and amorphous Si cannot share all parameters. Build baseline and perturbed cases offline and predict causality. Plan a falsification using: List bandgap, absorption and stability differences. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.
steps.observation: 列能隙、吸收與穩定差異。
steps.observationEn: List bandgap, absorption and stability differences.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「材料選擇」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping material selection verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「材料選擇」的兩情境模型、單位表及可反駁預測；說明「列能隙、吸收與穩定差異。」如何區分情境。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case model, units and a falsifiable prediction for material selection; explain how the proposed check distinguishes cases.

knowledge.title: 本單元機制
knowledge.text: CdTe、CIGS 與非晶矽不能共用所有參數。
knowledge.textEn: CdTe, CIGS and amorphous Si cannot share all parameters.

knowledge.title: 可區分原因的證據
knowledge.text: 列能隙、吸收與穩定差異。 必須保留基準、單位及不確定度，未有實測資料時只做假想案例判讀。
knowledge.textEn: List bandgap, absorption and stability differences. Retain references, units and uncertainty; without measured data, interpret hypothetical cases only.

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結
knowledge.text: 假設吸收係數 α=10⁶ m⁻¹、厚度 d=2 μm，理想無反射單程吸收 1−exp(−αd)=86.47%；d=3 μm 時為 95.02%。未包含載子收集及前後電極損失，因此不是效率。
knowledge.textEn: Assume α=10⁶ m⁻¹ and d=2 μm: ideal reflection-free single-pass absorption 1−exp(−αd)=86.47%; at 3 μm it is 95.02%. Collection and electrode losses are omitted, so this is not efficiency.

quiz.question: 審查「材料選擇」時，哪個判斷或驗證方法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or check is justified for material selection?
options: CdTe、CIGS 與非晶矽不能共用所有參數。
只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「材料選擇」的驗證。
只調整「材料選擇」的顯示結果吻合，便可當作獨立量測證據。
optionsEn: CdTe, CIGS and amorphous Si cannot share all parameters.
Equal nominal ratings justify skipping material selection verification.
Tuning the displayed material selection result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.
quiz.explanation: CdTe、CIGS 與非晶矽不能共用所有參數。 列能隙、吸收與穩定差異。
quiz.explanationEn: CdTe, CIGS and amorphous Si cannot share all parameters. List bandgap, absorption and stability differences.

summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect thin-film absorbers, monolithic interconnects and durability through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.

scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.
